name: suchipi-skills
description: suchipi's Claude Code skills. Provides drive-ui-in-docker (drive and observe arbitrary GUI apps running in Docker via noVNC + suchibot), drive-browser (drive and observe a real web browser on the host via node + puppeteer), eval-and-hillclimb (build evals for skills, rules, and CLAUDE.md, and hillclimb against them), and comment-on-markdown (leave review comments on a Markdown file in the browser via markdown-commenter, then have Claude address them).
